_comment: English locale for Hangman. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim. Keep neutral tokens untranslated: the '[L]' / '[LIGHT]' bracket formats, the single-letter guess {letter}, the column headers (C00, C01, ...) and '_' blanks inside {board}.

_slots.{board}: Neutral rendered board (C00/C01 column headers, revealed letters, '_' blanks); do not translate
_slots.{letter}: The guessed letter or full word (kept as typed)
_slots.{pct}: Percentage of characters guessed correctly, formatted to 2 decimals

prompt.intro:
Uli na kusakala Hangman. Cilonda ca kusakala ni kuwona cipande cakusakala kwa kutoa mawona matiya gha kutila gha kutila gha mawona.
Cilonda cilonda kutila nambari. Mawona gha kutila gha kutila gha mawona gha kutila '_'.

Kuna njia ziwili za kujibu. Ungaweza kutoa mawona matiya gha kutila gha fomu ya '[L]', kana ungaweza kutoa cipande cakusakala gha fomu ya '[LIGHT]'.
Ukapewa mawona gha kutila gha cipande, cipande cakusakala cikawoneka gha gridi.
Ukapewa cipande cakusakala gha cipande, ungawina.
Ukasakala, histori ya mawona gha kutila gha kutila gha mawona ikawoneka panshi. Tumia habari hiyo kuwona cipande cakusakala na kuwina.
Uli na 6 mawona yasiyo sahihi kabla ya kusakala kumalizika.

invalid.wrong_format: Fomu ya kusakala si sahihi. Ungaweza kujibu gha fomu ya 'herufi' kana 'cipande'.
invalid.already_guessed: Ungaweza kutoa herufi '{letter}' ambayo tayari imewekwa.

message.wrong_word: Kutoweka kwako kwa '{letter}' si cipande cakusakala.
message.letter_in: Kutoweka kwako kwa {letter} kuli gha cipande
message.letter_not_in: Kutoweka kwako kwa {letter} kuli si gha cipande. Uli na {tries_left} maisha yaliyobaki.

outcome.win_word: Hongera! Uliweza kukamilisha puzzle ya Hangman.
outcome.win_board: Hongera! Uliweza kukamilisha puzzle ya Hangman.
outcome.out_of_tries: Uliisha mawona yako. Uliweza kutoweka {pct} asilimia ya herufi kwa usahihi. Cipande cakusakala kilikuwa: {target_word}
